calls.statement:
SELECT tier, is_current, (valid_to = DATE '9999-12-31') AS open_ended, COUNT(*) AS version_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS members, MIN(valid_from), MAX(valid_from), MIN(valid_to), MAX(valid_to)
FROM dim_member GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3
SELECT COUNT(*) AS members_with_multiple_current FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE is_current GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)

SELECT
 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member) AS all_members,
 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member WHERE is_current) AS members_with_current,
 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member WHERE tier='Gold' AND is_current) AS gold_current,
 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member WHERE tier='Gold' AND DATE '2026-10-04' BETWEEN valid_from AND valid_to) AS gold_by_date_oct4,
 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member WHERE tier='Gold' AND DATE '2026-10-07' BETWEEN valid_from AND valid_to) AS gold_by_date_oct7,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT a.member_id FROM dim_member a JOIN dim_member b ON a.member_id=b.member_id AND a.member_key<b.member_key AND a.valid_from<=b.valid_to AND b.valid_from<=a.valid_to GROUP BY 1)) AS members_with_overlapping_versions,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dim_member WHERE member_id IS NULL OR member_key IS NULL) AS null_ids,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT member_key FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)) AS dup_member_keys

calls.statement:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS gold_current_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS gold_members,
 SUM(CASE WHEN join_date > DATE '2026-10-07' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS future_join,
 SUM(CASE WHEN valid_from < join_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS version_before_join,
 MIN(join_date), MAX(join_date)
FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND tier='Gold'
